basic_info.description: Modern contemporary home from circa 1987. Open Liv/Din/Kit Great Room experience with Bay views and a sliding door balcony. Nicely upgraded kitchen with quartz counters and SS apps. Two primary bedroom suite options, both with exterior walkout space. Lower level primary would also work great as a home office and Fam Rm with direct walkout access to south facing patio and back garden. Bathrooms await your own personal style and taste! Separate laundry/utility room. Two garages & driveways! Quiet northeast slope location with easy commuter & Highway access.
